label: BTC leg -20 percent (liquidBTC, eBTC)
description: BTC-denominated collateral is 4.11 percent of the book (4.14M USD at the probe pin), above the 2 percent materiality bar, so it ships as its own leg. liquidBTC and eBTC both respond to one BTC/USD axis instance so the correlation is structural, not a coincidence of two equal factors.
path_assumption: instantaneous mark at the shocked level; single-step, no path, no cascade feedback, no partial closes

propagation.note: accountant lens with a WBTC base composition (recon/derivation-notes.md:284); base_asset is the DEPLOYED composition read from PriceProviderV2.tokenConfig(liquidBTC).baseAsset = WBTC-on-OP 0x68f180fcCe6836688e9084f035309E29Bf0A2095 at the accept-r4 OP pin (see the pinned-read out_of_model entry)

accountant lens with a WBTC base composition; base_asset is the DEPLOYED composition read from PriceProviderV2.tokenConfig(eBTC).baseAsset = WBTC-on-OP 0x68f180fcCe6836688e9084f035309E29Bf0A2095 at the accept-r4 OP pin (see the pinned-read out_of_model entry)

WBTC on OP, the base asset liquidBTC and eBTC compose under (isBaseAsset=true at the accept-r4 pin; its own config is USD-terminal behind Chainlink WBTC/USD 0xD702DD976Fb76Fffc2D3963D037dfDae5b04E593). NOT in the chain collateral/borrow universe at the pin - the sweep's transitive closure reaches it, so its claim is committed here. It marks one-for-one on the same BTC/USD axis instance this scenario shocks

out_of_model: oracle lag and heartbeat behaviour during the move: the shock is applied as an instantaneous mark, while the real feeds update on deviation or heartbeat
deviation-trigger discreteness (a feed moves in rounds, not continuously)
liquidator liquidity, gas costs, execution latency and cascade dynamics
market correlations not mechanically implied by the read paths recorded in recon/derivation-notes.md
intra-sample price wicks: prices are 60-second point samples and an intra-interval spike is invisible by construction (D-012)

per-asset base_asset claims are the DEPLOYED composition graph read from PriceProviderV2.tokenConfig(token).baseAsset at the accept-r4 OP pin (block 154938071, hash 0xaf91dd4ba1975fc3b93e411586ce267892406ed8cb7152c5cefe1c368696c6bc, provider 0x44dd2372FE7B97C4B4D6a7d4DeCf72466485BAcB) - a hash-pinned SAMPLE with no continuity claim (chain-truth R3.1), fixture-welded in internal/risk/testdata/tokenconfig_accept_r4.json
the axis key 0x2260FAC5E5542a773Aa44fBCfeDf7C193bc2C599 is WBTC on Ethereum mainnet and is used here ONLY as the BTC/USD unit of account; it is not a held collateral asset on either engine
